nodes.rationale: Keyed by Discogs release ID; stores artist, title, label, catalog number, format, country, year, genre, style, tracklist, notes, barcode/identifiers, cover image URL, last fetched date, cache source, and optionally sync status. Tokens are explicitly never cached.

nodes.rationale: Interface plus local storage implementation added in 5E before any UI wiring; write path (5F, after successful Discogs detail load, with cache-save failures handled safely) and read path (5G, offline fallback clearly marked with last fetched date) were added as separate slices.
